name: The Crown of Will
label: Quest
description: Only one thing remains. The Crown is to go to Sharlindra in the Undercity, who will make sure it reaches Lady Sylvanas.

clips.title: The story
paras: Only one thing remains. The Crown is to go to Sharlindra in the Undercity, who will make sure it reaches Lady Sylvanas.

Melisara says all that remains is to take the Crown to Sharlindra in the Undercity, and she will pass it on to Lady Sylvanas. Melisara also warns you against thinking of using it for your own purposes. Mug'Thol's fate, Melisara says, is illustration enough.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: All that remains is to deliver the Crown of Will to Sharlindra in the Undercity. She will see that it is delivered to Lady Sylvanas. I would warn you against thinking to use it for your own purposes, friend, Mug'Thol's fate should be illustration enough.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Yes? Do you have something to report?

clips.title: Completion
paras: So this is the relic the ogre used to duck the will of the Dark Lady...

Strange that something so simple could wield so great a power. And to fall into as clumsy hands as those. Well done, friend, I will deliver the crown to Lady Sylvanas, and see that she hears of your accomplishment.
